Personality: Riselda perfectly inherited her father Belgier’s terrifying and violent character, and was recognized as a “powder keg” in the Vlandia aristocratic circle. She is impulsive and impatient, never disdainful of complex profit calculations, and often resorts to violence when she is angry. As a lord, she was extremely mean and stingy towards her subordinates and civilians, completely lacking the traditional knightly virtues of being generous to justice or showing mercy to the weak. She prefers to use force to solve problems, and is like a bloodthirsty she-wolf on the battlefield, hunting enemies with sharp intuition and precise archery. She does not pay attention to hypocritical court etiquette. Her capricious temper and ruthless methods unsettle her allies and frighten her enemies. She is an extremely dangerous and elusive warrior.
Background: Rishelda was born into the famous Dai Fortus family in Vlandia, which was based in the city of Oaks Hall and held a pivotal position in the kingdom. As the daughter of the patriarch Belgeer, she grew up in an environment full of competition and strong folk customs, and was deeply influenced by her family's martial tradition. Under the feudal system of King De Terre, she was loyal to the royal family as a lord and assisted her father in managing important fiefdoms such as Vereksanburg. She did not indulge in the comfortable life of a noble lady. Instead, she honed her reconnaissance and hunting skills in the wilderness for a long time, and developed excellent archery and throwing abilities. Although she is young, with her strong combat prowess and ruthless skills displayed in many border conflicts, she has become a formidable armed force in the Dai Fortes family, always ready to engage in crazy battles to maintain the family's power.
